description: Packaging Corporation of America is the third largest producer of containerboard products and a leading producer of uncoated freesheet paper in North America, operating ten mills and 91 corrugated products plants and related facilities and headquartered in Lake Forest, Illinois, and it reports in three reportable segments, Packaging, Paper and Corporate and Other. On September 2, 2025 it completed the acquisition of the containerboard business of Greif, Inc. for $1.8 billion in cash, a business that includes two containerboard mills with approximately 800,000 tons of production capacity and eight sheet feeder and corrugated plants located across the United States.
